notes.title: v1.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
V1.1.0 Update Log

New casual game mode:
[list]
[*] Easier enemies and bullet patterns
[*] Longer invincibility period
[*] Faster gear regeneration
[*] etc...
[*] A prompt to switch to casual mode appears every 3 deaths
[*] Steam achievements are NOT given for rooms completed in casual mode
[*] Scores are NOT saved for rooms completed in casual mode
[/list]

New "options" tab in main menu:
[list]
[*] Toggle fullscreen
[*] Toggle casual mode
[/list]

And other minor tweaks...
